# Twitch Streamer Dashboard Redesign

## 🎯 Core Design Philosophy

> **Problem with current Twitch dashboard:** Information overload, poor hierarchy, scattered metrics, and weak real-time feedback during live streams.

---

## 📐 Layout Architecture

### Three-Panel Responsive Layout

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  HEADER: Stream Status Bar                               │
├──────────────┬──────────────────────────┬───────────────┤
│              │                          │               │
│  LEFT PANEL  │     CENTER PANEL         │  RIGHT PANEL  │
│  (Metrics)   │     (Stream Preview      │  (Chat &      │
│              │      + Controls)         │   Activity)   │
│  ~20% width  │     ~55% width           │  ~25% width   │
│              │                          │               │
└──────────────┴──────────────────────────┴───────────────┘
```

---

## 🔴 1. Stream Status Bar (Header)

Always-visible top bar showing the most critical live information.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  🔴 LIVE  02:34:17  │  👁 4,231  │  📈 +127 peak  │  💜 892 subs │
│  "Playing Elden Ring - Road to Platinum"                        │
│  [Edit Title]  [End Stream]  [Quick Clip ✂️]  [Raid 🚀]         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Key Features:**
- Pulsing red dot when live (vs static in current design)
- Stream duration with elapsed time
- Viewer count with trend arrow (↑↓)
- One-click **Quick Clip** button
- **End Stream** requires confirmation modal (prevent accidents)

---

## 📊 2. Left Panel — Live Metrics

### Performance Cards (Glanceable)

```
┌─────────────────────┐
│  👁 VIEWERS         │
│                     │
│    4,231            │
│  ▲ 12% vs avg       │
│  [Spark line graph] │
└─────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────┐
│  💜 NEW SUBS        │
│                     │
│    +14  today       │
│  Tier breakdown:    │
│  T1: 11  T2: 2  T3:1│
└─────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────┐
│  💰 BITS TODAY      │
│                     │
│    12,450           │
│  Top: PogChamp99    │
│       3,000 bits    │
└─────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────┐
│  📡 STREAM HEALTH   │
│                     │
│  ████████░░  82%    │
│  Bitrate: 6,000kbps │
│  FPS: 60  ✅        │
│  Dropped: 0.3%      │
└─────────────────────┘
```

### Channel Point Tracker
```
┌─────────────────────┐
│  ⭐ CHANNEL POINTS  │
│  Redeems (live)     │
│  ─────────────────  │
│  • Hydrate! x3      │
│  • Song Request x1  │
│  • !D20 Roll  x7    │
│  [Manage Queue]     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

## 🎬 3. Center Panel — Stream Control Hub

### Stream Preview
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                        │
│         LIVE STREAM PREVIEW            │
│           (16:9 Thumbnail)             │
│                                        │
│  [PIP mode] [Fullscreen] [Snapshot]   │
└────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Scene Manager (OBS-style integrated)
```
SCENES
┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐
│ 🎮 LIVE  │ │  BRB 💤  │ │  INTRO  │ │  OUTRO  │
│ [ACTIVE] │ │          │ │          │ │          │
└──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘
  Click to switch scenes — drag to reorder

```

### Quick Actions Toolbar
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  QUICK ACTIONS                   │
│                                                  │
│  [🎵 Music]  [📢 Ad Break]  [📊 Poll]           │
│  [🎰 Prediction]  [✂️ Clip]  [📣 Shoutout]      │
│  [⏱ Timer]  [🎁 Hype Train]  [📌 Marker]        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Poll / Prediction Creator (Inline)
```
When [📊 Poll] clicked:
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  CREATE POLL                     │
│  ─────────────────────────────   │
│  Question: [_________________]   │
│  Option 1: [_________________]   │
│  Option 2: [_________________]   │
│  + Add option                    │
│  Duration: [60s ▾]               │
│  [Launch Poll 🚀]  [Cancel]      │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Activity Feed (Timeline)
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ⚡ ACTIVITY FEED                         │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────   │
│  🔔 02:31  StreamerFan followed           │
│  💜 02:28  XxGamer99 subscribed (1yr)    │
│  🎉 02:25  HYPE TRAIN started! (x2)      │
│  🚀 02:20  Raid from PixelWitch (340)    │
│  💰 02:15  ProDonor: 5,000 bits          │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────   │
│  [View Full History]                     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 💬 4. Right Panel — Chat & Audience

### Smart Chat
```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  CHAT  [Popout ↗]            │
│  ─────────────────────────   │
│  🔍 [Search chat...]         │
│                              │
│  [Mod ⚔️] CoolUser: pog!!   │
│  [VIP 💎] Viewer2: LUL      │
│  ProFan: first time here!   │  ← New viewer highlight
│  SubFan: let's gooo 🎉      │
│                              │
│  ────── PINNED ──────        │
│  📌 "!discord → twitch.tv/  │
│  discord" — streamer        │
│                              │
│  [Pin Message] [Clear Chat] │
└──────────────────────────────┘

│ [Slow: OFF] [Sub-only: OFF] │
│ [Emote-only: OFF]  [+] mods │

[Type a message...       ] [Send]
```

### Viewer Insights (Collapsible)
```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  👥 AUDIENCE BREAKDOWN  [▾]  │
│  ─────────────────────────   │
│  New viewers:    34%  🟢     │
│  Returning:      44%  🔵     │
│  Subscribers:    22%  💜     │
│                              │
│  Top chatters (10m):         │
│  1. HypeUser99 — 47 msgs     │
│  2. LoyalFan   — 31 msgs     │
│  3. ModHelper  — 28 msgs     │
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

### Mod Queue (Collapsed by default)
```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  🛡 MOD QUEUE  (3) [▾]       │
│  ─────────────────────────   │
│  ⚠️ Potential spam — User1   │
│  ⚠️ Flagged word — User2     │
│  [Review] [Dismiss all]      │
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 🎨 Visual Design System

### Color Palette
| Token | Color | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--live-red` | `#FF4444` | Live status, urgent |
| `--twitch-purple` | `#9147FF` | Brand, CTAs |
| `--surface-dark` | `#1A1A2E` | Panel backgrounds |
| `--surface-mid` | `#252540` | Card backgrounds |
| `--text-primary` | `#EFEFF1` | Main text |
| `--text-muted` | `#ADADB8` | Secondary text |
| `--success` | `#00C853` | Health good, growth |
| `--warning` | `#FFB300` | Caution states |

### Typography Scale
```css
--font-display:  28px / 700  /* Viewer count, key numbers */
--font-heading:  16px / 600  /* Panel titles */
--font-body:     14px / 400  /* Chat, descriptions */
--font-small:    12px / 400  /* Labels, timestamps */
--font-micro:    10px / 500  /* Tags, badges */
```

---

## ⚙️ 5. Settings & Personalization

### Dashboard Customization
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CUSTOMIZE DASHBOARD  [Save Layout]     │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────  │
│  ☑ Show stream preview                  │
│  ☑ Viewer count sparkline               │
│  ☐ Bits leaderboard                     │
│  ☑ Activity feed                        │
│  ☑ Scene switcher                       │
│  ☐ Advanced stream stats                │
│                                         │
│  Chat font size:  [──●──────]  14px     │
│  Panel layout:    [Default ▾]           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 📱 Mobile Companion View

For streamers monitoring on phone:

```
┌─────────────────────┐
│ 🔴 LIVE  02:34:17   │
│ 👁 4,231  ↑12%      │
├─────────────────────┤
│ CHAT          [Mod] │
│ ...                 │
│ ...                 │
├─────────────────────┤
│ [📊Poll][✂️Clip][🎁]│
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

## 🔔 Smart Notification System

```
Priority levels:
🔴 CRITICAL  → Stream health drop, disconnect
🟡 IMPORTANT → Raid incoming, Hype Train
🟢 INFO      → New follow, sub, clip created

Rules:
• No notification during active chat interaction
• Bundle follows (e.g. "14 new followers in 5 min")
• Raid warning appears 30s before it arrives
```

---

## 🆚 Current vs Redesigned

| Feature | Current Twitch | Redesign |
|---|---|---|
| Stream health visibility | Buried in settings | Always-visible header |
| Scene switching | OBS only | Integrated panel |
| Activity feed | Separate page | Real-time sidebar |
| Poll creation | Multiple clicks | Inline quick action |
| Mobile support | Very limited | Companion app view |
| Chat moderation | Reactive | Proactive mod queue |
| Layout flexibility | Fixed | Drag & drop panels |
| Viewer breakdown | Analytics only | Live during stream |

---

## 🚀 Key UX Principles Applied

1. **Progressive disclosure** — Advanced tools hidden until needed
2. **Glanceability** — Critical numbers readable in <1 second
3. **Reduce context switching** — Everything in one view
4. **Error prevention** — Confirm destructive actions (end stream)
5. **Streamer-first** — Designed for use DURING a live broadcast

---
